title: run-status.mjs projection tests: /aris state endpoint honesty
description: The host row's only RPC projects loop artifacts. Test the handler at the unit seam: missing artifacts reported exists:false (never guessed), malformed REVIEW_STATE.json surfaces stateError verbatim, valid state passes through, criticisms lifted verbatim or absent, newest .aris/runs run projected with phases as stored.

title: routing.mjs fast-check properties: family, effort ladder, selection order, fail-closed
description: Example tests pin specific cases; properties must hold for all inputs: family from the model id with delimited keywords (0 or >=2 matches -> unknown), effort candidates are exactly the ladder suffix at the requested tier (ultra -> max,xhigh; omitted -> xhigh; max never falls below), candidateRoutes keeps configured order with pins first, dedups, skips unknown- and same-family, and selectReviewerRoute tries candidate-major x effort-minor in exactly that order and fails closed with REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE.

title: aris-host row disposal: effects, run-status RPC, settings, ARIS_REPO all withdrawn
description: index.mjs apply() publishes reviewer settings, ARIS_REPO and the /aris run-status RPC via ctx.effect/ctx.inject; none of these had a teardown test. Test the apply/dispose contract at the unit seam (bad config fails before any effect; operator-set ARIS_REPO wins and survives dispose; disposal restores everything; re-apply works) and the real lifecycle on the rig (web starts with the bundle, stops cleanly, profile tree fully removable).

title: SPEC drift: byte-identical claim, call-site counts, run-status.mjs missing, pwsh
description: SPEC §1 byte-identical claim false; mcp__codex__codex call-site counts stale; run-status.mjs not in layout; WRITE_TOOLS includes pwsh, SPEC omits it.

title: reviewer.mjs untested: same-family reply guard and read-only sandbox mutants survive
description: Mutants removing the reply-time same-family guard or giving read-only sandbox write tools both survived the suite. Add reviewer contract tests.

title: preset-drift test silently skips without DSH_ROOT
description: dsh/test/preset-drift.test.mjs calls t.skip when dsh is not found; a required test must fail, not skip.

title: concurrent mcp__codex__codex-reply on one thread loses a round
description: reviewer.mjs reply isConcurrencySafe true; runRound loads, runs, saves without lock; two concurrent replies each push onto a stale copy and the second save drops the first round.

title: effortCandidates("max") returns [max,xhigh], below the requested tier
description: routing.mjs effortCandidates maps max and ultra to [max,xhigh]; SPEC says never below the requested tier. For an explicit max request, xhigh is below. Decide: ultra->[max] and max->[max]? SPEC ladder says ultra->max,xhigh. Fix per spec property.
close_reason: red 1b62452 + fix 3f5fe36: effortCandidates('max') -> ['max'], ladder property pins it (P-05); caught again by mutant M1

title: CI: node job for dsh/ in GitHub Actions
description: test-suite.yml runs only pytest and excludes dsh/**; add a node job running the fast dsh suites.
acceptance_criteria: Workflow runs dsh fast suites on push to main touching dsh/.

title: Release procedure: RELEASING.md + CHANGELOG.md; cut release in round 3
description: Follow new-dsh-plugin references/release.md: SemVer, prerelease channel matching DSH alpha, exact peer pins, CHANGELOG, annotated tag vX.Y.Z-alpha.N.
acceptance_criteria: RELEASING.md and CHANGELOG.md committed; round 3 tag pushed if all required suites green.

title: Bugs: red then fix commits; mutation campaign
description: Per bug: red commit with failing test, then fix commit. Run deliberate mutants against new tests and record caught N/N in TESTING.md.
acceptance_criteria: All bug beads closed with red/fix shas; mutants caught N/N recorded.

title: Traceability: dsh/TESTING.md property -> test -> surface -> result
description: Table mapping every SPEC property to tests with last result, seed, run count, DSH versions; no silent skips.
acceptance_criteria: Every SPEC property maps to >=1 test; skips fail required suites.

title: dsh-TUI inertness property against real dsh-TUI
description: TUI surface not applicable (presets are web-only). Inertness: loading the ARIS bundle into a real dsh-TUI profile in a private tmux socket must not break or alter Launchpad or chat under generated key sequences.
acceptance_criteria: Generated sequences on Launchpad and chat green with ARIS loaded; seed replay works.

title: Playwright property tests against real dsh web
description: fast-check generated action sequences over the ARIS preset picker, ARIS tab and reviewer tools in a real dsh web (rig + mock), invariants after each step, FC_SEED/NUM_RUNS replay, screenshots on failure.
acceptance_criteria: >=25 sequences/round while iterating, >=100 across >=3 seeds for release; all green.

title: Vendor the rig into test/rig with source commit note
description: Copy nix-config skills/new-dsh-plugin/scripts/{rig.mjs,mock-llm.mjs} into dsh/test/rig/, record source commit, import by relative path only.
acceptance_criteria: Files vendored with provenance header; no imports from ~/.agents or nix-config.
close_reason: Vendored dsh/test/rig/{rig.mjs,mock-llm.mjs} from nix-config 6a7e6130 with sha256 + local change list in dsh/test/rig/PROVENANCE.md; imported by relative path only

title: Nix environment: flake.nix with package, devShell, checks, e2e app
description: flake.nix: packages.default (version from package.json), devShells.default (node, tmux, playwright-driver.browsers, beads, pinned dsh + dsh-TUI 0.14.0), checks running fast suites in sandbox, apps.e2e for real-client suites. Inputs pinned by rev; nix-dsh rev = nix-config pin f0ca0d7.
acceptance_criteria: nix flake check passes; nix develop provides all tools; nix run .#e2e runs real-client suites.

title: SPEC.md: every property with stable ID, oracle, surfaces
description: Collect properties from dsh/SPEC.md, README, code comments and audit findings into dsh/SPEC.md with IDs P-01.., observable oracle and surface(s); record TUI not-applicable rationale; fix SPEC drift (byte-identical claim, call-site counts, run-status.mjs, pwsh).
acceptance_criteria: Every property has ID+oracle+surface; SPEC drift items corrected; §6 acceptance items mapped to IDs.

title: Source reconcile: main == deployed nix-config pin
description: Compare main with nix-config flake.lock dsh-aris-better rev and pkgs/dsh-aris.nix; commit a sync if they differ.
acceptance_criteria: main HEAD tree equals the nix-config pinned rev (or a sync commit makes it so); evidence recorded.
close_reason: No sync needed: main HEAD a52a964 == nix-config flake.lock dsh-aris-better rev; git archive of a52a964 (minus dsh/test, as pkgs/dsh-aris.nix installs) is diff -r IDENTICAL to deployed /nix/store/sqi22vx0z0a8hgkmbnh95zs5b0lzn6m6-dsh-aris-better-0.2.0-alpha.1

title: dsh-aris-better: spec-driven real-client test system, Nix env, bug fixes, SemVer releases
description: Ralph loop (3 rounds) owned by teammate dsh-aris-better-eng. Scope: dsh/ layer only.
acceptance_criteria: All step beads closed with evidence; required suites green on dsh 0.2.1-alpha.2 + dsh-TUI 0.14.0; release tagged in round 3.
